title: Bimodal Thickness Reinitialization with 15% Relaxed Total Thickness Budget
scientific_hypothesis: The convergent thickness bands discovered in iteration 13 (~70-75 nm and ~135-145 nm) represent local optima for the HfO2/SiO2 material pair. Reinitializing with explicit bimodal distribution centered at these values while relaxing total thickness constraints by 15% will allow the optimizer to explore wider bandwidth solutions previously filtered by validity constraints, potentially improving best_target_score beyond 0.793.
design_principle: Bimodal thickness initialization exploits discovered convergent bands; relaxed total thickness budget reduces validity filtering that eliminated wide-bandwidth candidates in prior rounds.
proposed_topology: 24-layer alternating stack: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | Fused Silica
soft_objectives: maximize mean transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band
maximize mean reflectance in 300-450 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: thickness tolerance analysis with relative uniform error model
outermost SiO2 layer for environmental durability per evidence
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack theory for high-reflectance bands
Bimodal optimization for multi-band spectral requirements
expected_advantages: Wider search space due to relaxed thickness budget
known_risks: May converge to similar local optimum as iteration 13
Relaxed thickness may increase fabrication sensitivity
execution_request_english: Optimize a 24-layer HfO2/SiO2 alternating dielectric stack on fused silica substrate. Initialize layer thicknesses with bimodal distribution: odd layers (HfO2) centered at 145 nm ± 15 nm, even layers (SiO2) centered at 75 nm ± 10 nm. Set total physical thickness maximum bound 15% higher than iteration 13 baseline. Optimize over 300-1700 nm wavelength range with coherent smatrix solver. Maximize mean transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band and mean reflectance in 300-450 nm band simultaneously. Apply gradient_thickness optimizer with relative uniform tolerance model. Layer sequence: HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2 (24 layers total, starting with HfO2 on substrate). Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 300-450 nm, 1000-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1000-1700 nm; high reflection in 300-450 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: low transmission in 300-450 nm; low reflection in 1000-1700 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count <= 30; materials restricted to HfO2 and SiO2.
revision_reason: Direct implementation of feedback directive: bimodal thickness reinitialization at 75±10 nm and 145±15 nm centers, plus 15% total thickness budget relaxation to address validity constraint bottleneck observed in iteration 13.
